description: Combined discounts are off by 0.5; percent_off (never named) floors with //.

issue.title: Cart total is a little off when a coupon and member pricing are combined
issue.body: With a single item at 100.00, a 10 off coupon and member pricing (5 off), `Cart.total()` in checkout/cart.py returns 86.0 but the price should be 85.5. Either discount on its own is fine.
